gap: Check whether the improved realized fixed-wing forecasts also reduce the complete learned attitude-to-rate recurrence toward the previously verified Cascade plant response.
roster: All 14 saved conditional origins and five recorded states/commands per origin. At each origin, load the new candidate's last causally updated readout, or the prefix model at the initial origin; do not fit. Use that one fixed readout for all five steps. Reconstruct history/filter/memory from the actual recorded past at each measured state. Differentiate physical right SO(3) attitude perturbation with world velocity, body rate, commands and latent history held fixed.
measurement: Use the maintained physical rollout, not only the instantaneous head. Save the full 3x3 attitude-to-body-rate Jacobian after each individual 50 ms step from each measured state, and after a five-command 250 ms free rollout from each origin. Compare each matrix with the authenticated Cascade one-step and five-step matrices in the same physical tangent coordinates. Report median local Frobenius norm and mismatch, median 250 ms largest singular value and mismatch, and per-origin gains. Also preserve candidate absolute physical 250 ms rate RMSE; local derivative agreement does not substitute for forecast accuracy.
checks: Authenticate source packs, require exact origin rows and all finite matrices; check JAX derivatives against centered physical finite differences at the first and middle origin to relative error <=0.0001. Save every matrix and all summary inputs; verify summaries from saved arrays without any fitting, model call or simulator call. Do not alter or rerun the candidate fit.
interpretation: The plant replay already passed its own truth gate. This is a local and 250 ms physical tangent check on one fixed-wing airframe, not a global stability proof or a held-out-vehicle test. A smaller derivative norm need not mean better directional agreement.
